backend.不同词形总数按整个范围去重，不能把各篇的不同词形数直接相加。: Distinct forms are deduplicated across the entire scope; per-text type counts cannot simply be added.
backend.完整词形分别计数；点击形式或次数查看原句。导出 JSON 包含本次全部词频和例证: Count complete word forms separately. Click a form or count to inspect its source examples. JSON export includes all frequencies and example positions in this run.
backend.仅计入当前有效关联的语素条目，按已指定类型筛选，不自动删除词缀。语素出现次数与涉: Count currently valid morpheme links and filter by assigned type, without automatically stripping affixes. Morpheme occurrences and containing word tokens are counted separately. Repeated morphemes may occur more than once in a word; examples are shown by word cell. Unspecified types remain in the full morpheme list.
backend.词频项目已不存在于当前结果中: The frequency item is not present in this result
backend.筛选词形、语素或释义: Filter word forms, morphemes or glosses

backend.条件只筛选条目自身资料，例句不参与条目筛选。分类未填写的项另列；一个条目属于多个: Conditions filter the entry’s own information; examples are excluded. Empty classifications form a separate group. An entry may belong to multiple groups, so group counts can overlap.
backend.只计入符合条目条件的有效关联；整词与相同单语素关联去重。占比以筛选后的关联出现次: Count valid links to entries matching the conditions. Deduplicate identical whole-word and single-morpheme links. Percentages use the selected link occurrences; entries may occur in multiple groups, whose counts cannot simply be added. Overview and word-form frequencies still show the entire material scope.

CORPUS ANALYSIS

语料分析

从形式出发，检索语境、比较分布、收集研究例证。

词数与句数统计

词数按词格计算词次，不是不同词形数或语素数。空词格、纯标点格及纯井号边界格不计；独立例句库包含词典及调查独立例句，同一句的多处引用只计一次；文本引用仍归所属文本。

语料范围 当前语言全部文本
⟦0⟧ 仅按语码条件筛选时逐句显示；填写检索内容后显示相应命中。逐句发言人：手动指定优先，否则继承轨道；继承冲突不计入任一人。文本合作者：只限制文本范围，不推断句子发言人。选择文本、文件夹或文本合作者后，独立例句不会纳入。

保存筛选条件；新加入且符合条件的材料也会纳入。未填写的信息不会被推断。
首项留空可统计该层全部出现；仅按语码筛选时逐句显示。附加条件同时满足；词距不计纯标点、空格和音系边界。可纳入独立例句，同一记录不因多次引用重复计入。独立例句的整句词条引用不当作逐词关联。额外标注层可直接检索；书写与词典分类通过有效关联检索，书写指词条书写形式。“不属于”仅检查已有分类的项。

设置检索条件后运行。每次执行自动保留记录，翻页和切换视图不增加记录。

分析记录

整个项目最多保留最近 30 次有效执行。过期记录及其结果自动清理；手动收藏、固定快照和研究分组独立保留。

6ac8ac00e5e40c.en:
CORPUS ANALYSIS

Analysis

Search contexts, compare distributions, and collect evidence for your analysis.

Counts

Counts word tokens by word cell. Empty cells, punctuation, and boundary-only cells are excluded. Dictionary and elicitation examples are included once per source sentence. References to text sentences count under their source text.

Scope All texts in this language
⟦0⟧ Language-use filters alone return sentences; search text returns hits. Explicit speakers take precedence over tier inheritance; conflicting assignments are excluded. Text contributors restrict texts without implying who spoke. Selecting texts, folders, or text contributors excludes standalone examples.

Save these filters. Newly added matching materials will be included. Missing metadata is not inferred.
Leave the first query blank to count all occurrences. Additional conditions must all match. Word distance excludes punctuation, spaces, and phonological boundaries. Standalone examples are counted once; sentence references do not imply word links. Extra tiers are searched directly; written forms and dictionary classes require valid links. Exclusion tests only classified items.

Set the query and run it. Runs are saved automatically; changing pages or views does not create another run.

Analysis history

Keeps the last 30 valid runs per project. Older runs and results are removed automatically. Saved queries, snapshots, and collections are retained separately.

fa267a12a70fb2.zh:
Word 文本导入

每句范围可包含多个词格表；表格换行不分句。导入为新文本，可整体撤销。旧 .doc 请先另存为 .docx。

附加标注层

点词格间的 ↵ 拆句；可与下句合并。拆句后请核对 IPA、译文和备注：原句字段保留在含原句起点的部分。

排版选项

导出 IPA、语素、当前有效标注、翻译、备注及附加层。长句分成多段表格，仍在同一例句范围内。词典关联等研究关系请使用语言数据包保存。
fa267a12a70fb2.en:
Import Word text

An example may contain multiple word-cell tables. Table wrapping does not split sentences. Imports create a new text and can be undone together. Save old .doc files as .docx first.

Extra tier

Select ↵ between cells to split a sentence, or merge it with the next. Check IPA, translation, and notes after splitting: source fields stay with the part containing the original start.

Layout options

Exports IPA, morphemes, current glosses, translation, notes, and extra tiers. Long sentences use several tables within one example. Preserve dictionary links and research relationships using a language package.

7681b55489796b.zh:
自动关联词典

词形须完全一致；标注须完整匹配义项简短释义与条目、词类用法、具体形式的固有特征。普通尾部标签按标签库识别（含别名），允许调整顺序，不能缺少或多出特征。匹配整词和切分后的语素；不重复关联未切分的单个语素。

已登记的形式变体参与匹配；自定义书写形式不参与。复杂关系、括号和语素边界保留结构，不推断其与固有特征的组合。已有的关联会保留；多个条目或意义同时匹配时，留待手动选择。

忽略词形标记的候选（需勾选确认） 比较去掉所选标记后的完整单位，不查找任意子串。完全匹配排前；同标注的忽略标记候选仍会列出，多目标需选择。
7681b55489796b.en:
Auto-link entries

Forms must match exactly. Glosses must include the sense gloss and all inherent entry, POS-group, and form features. Trailing labels, including aliases, may be reordered but not omitted or added. Matches whole words and segmented morphemes without duplicating links to an unsegmented single morpheme.

Registered variants participate; custom written forms do not. Complex relations, brackets, and morpheme boundaries retain their structure. Feature combinations are not inferred. Existing links are retained; multiple matching entries or meanings require manual selection.

Candidates ignoring form markers (confirm selection) Compares complete units after removing selected markers, not arbitrary substrings. Exact matches appear first. Same-gloss candidates ignoring markers are also shown; choose among multiple targets.
